# Chatalyst — names nobody may wear, shipped and maintained by the plugin.
# version: 1
#
# THIS FILE IS REPLACED ON UPGRADE. Do not edit it: a newer Chatalyst overwrites it
# with its own list, and your changes are gone. Put YOUR names — your staff, your
# server's brand — in players.yml under Nick.Protected_Names. That file is yours and
# the plugin never rewrites it. Both lists apply together.
#
# One name per line. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Matching
# ignores case, spaces and look-alike characters, so 'Ibai' also covers 'ibai',
# 'I b a i' and full-width. A name here never blocks its real owner.
